sentences.text: Applicant is in detention since 20.02.2024.
First application was dismissed as withdrawn.
2. As per the prosecution story, allegation against the present applicant is that he has committed rape upon the prosecutrix who is mentally retarded.
On the basis of aforesaid, case has been registered against the present applicant under the aforesaid Sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
He is in jail since 20.02.2024.
It is submitted that there is improvement in the court NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:42277 2 MCRC-38572-2025 statement of prosecutrix.
There is no criminal record of applicant.
Charge sheet has been filed and the conclusion of trial will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant and has submitted that present applicant has committed rape upon the prosecutrix who is mentally retarded.
Prosecutrix and other witnesses in their court statement have deposed against the present applicant.
At this stage, minute appreciation evidence cannot be done.
Hence, the applicant does not deserve grant of bail.
